name: Demon Ichor
description: The caustic black blood of a coreling. Used in ward ink and certain dark rituals.
lore: Demon ichor burns skin on contact and smells of hot iron and rot. Properly refined by a skilled Warder, it becomes the base for ward ink that adheres to any surface permanently. The Krasian Sharum collect it as a matter of course after every night's battle. Northerners tend to leave it on the ground.
